name: Cotswold Airport Running Festival
cutoff: 3 hours for half marathon to reopen runway
course: Flat runway and airport roads; half mini loop plus four laps, 10K two, 5K one.
transport: Free on-site parking; arrive early for queues. Event village opens 08:00.
facilities: Bag drop, lap-end water, portable toilets each lap; no on-course water for 5K.
rules: Minimum ages: half 17, 10K 15, 5K 11. Half has a firm three-hour runway reopening limit.
reason: The flat runway is appealing for even pacing, but exposure and a fixed half-marathon cutoff are material. Lap counts and 5K water availability differ by distance.

name: Run Thorpe Park 5K & 10K
course: Resort roads before public opening; 5K one lap, 10K two.
transport: Free parking only until 13:00, then charge applies; allow time for security.
facilities: Bag drop, Dome toilets, course water; race entry includes full-day park admission.
rules: Minimum ages: 5K 11, 10K 15. Spectators require a separate limited ticket for early access.
reason: Full-day resort admission is included, but the 08:00 gate closure, short cutoffs and parking charge after 13:00 are essential to planning the day.

name: Colchester Zoo Stampede 10K
course: Starts inside zoo, continues on closed local roads, returns to event village.
transport: Free zoo parking; organiser advises arriving before 07:30. Rail stations are about four miles away.
facilities: Bag drop, toilets and chip timing; race entry includes zoo entry on race day.
rules: Plan the family visit separately if spectators need their own admission; check final spectator terms.
reason: A zoo start and included admission make this more than a standard road 10K. The early parking recommendation and 77m ascent are useful decision details.

name: Run Gatwick Half Marathon & 5K
course: Single-loop half from Crawley via Charlwood and Manor Royal, passing under Gatwick flight path; town-centre finish.
transport: No participant parking at Southgate Park; a separate car-park plan will be sent with final race information.
facilities: Bag drop, portable toilets, half-marathon water about every 5km; 5K has no on-course water.
rules: Collect race pack at the village from 07:30 with confirmation and photo ID.
reason: A flat point-to-point-feeling loop with a distinctive airport backdrop. No on-site parking and no 5K water station make the final logistics guide important.

name: Leeds Running Festival August
course: Mixed tarmac and trail park footpaths around lakeside, woodland and open parkland.
transport: Roundhay Park is three miles north of central Leeds; bus routes 2 and 12 serve the area.
facilities: Chip timing, event village and finish refreshments.
rules: Minimum ages: half 17, 10K 15, 5K 11. Check underfoot conditions for the trail sections.
reason: A late-summer multi-distance park race on mixed surfaces. It offers an autumn-race tune-up, but footwear should suit both tarmac and trail.

name: MBNA Chester 10K
course: Wide roads towards Mollington, then city-centre return past Town Hall and Cathedral to Eastgate Street finish.
transport: Chester station is about a 10-minute walk from the Racecourse; check closures before driving.
facilities: Bag drop, chip timing and event village.
rules: Start and finish are in different places; arrange post-race meeting near Eastgate Street rather than the start.
reason: The city-centre finish beneath the Eastgate Clock is a highlight, while the separate start at the racecourse matters for bags and supporters.

name: Run Tatton Half Marathon November
course: Two undulating, closed-road laps through Tatton Park and along Mereheath Lane.
transport: Free parking by event village; marshals at entrance from 06:45. Knutsford station about half a mile from park entrance.
facilities: Bag drop, toilets, two water stations passed each lap and pacers.
rules: Organiser prose still references 2026 and says Remembrance Sunday, although 7 November 2027 is a week earlier; verify final ceremonial schedule.
reason: A two-lap park half with moderate climbing, pacers and free parking. Stale event prose means runners should confirm the final race-day schedule.
